content.comment_body: Hello, I created a project with [product_name] [version_no], but after updating to [version_no] and later to [version_no], I encountered an error when clicking on the navigator buttons. Despite the alerts, uploading to my [version_no] device works, but the navigator displays nothing. Has anyone else experienced this or have suggestions to resolve it?
If you still have the [version_no] project, can you upload it as a ZIP file?

Hi, the attached file contains the project with all objects removed. I haven't deleted any files from the directory; the pages and their names remain, and the issue persists. I also tested this on another PC with [product_name] [version_no]. Thanks for taking the time to assist. If necessary, I might have to rebuild everything from [version_no] just to convert my project and add a login page.
It seems that the project gets corrupted or is at risk of corruption during the upgrade. Upgrading with [product_name] [version_no] shows me the same error message as you described.

So there's no option but to redo everything? Thank you for your help. If I upgrade to [version_no] with [version_no], do you know if the slow webserver issue will be fixed? I saw in an update notice that performance had supposedly been improved, but does that affect the slowness previously seen between [article_no] and [article_no]?

With [product_name] [version_no] and the new [product_name] [version_no], loading a project has become much faster. Accessing the web server via browser is also much quicker. However, this doesn't improve anything for [product_name] [version_no] or [version_no].

Hello. I rebuilt my program starting from an old version ([product_name] [version_no]) and the conversion succeeded. However, I now have two issues: 1) The chosen font isn't actually applied—I've set Century Gothic everywhere, but everything remains in Arial, even after trying different fonts. Edit: The font issue only exists in [product_name]; it looks correct in the web browser after upload. 2) I no longer see preview thumbnails of images uploaded to the My graph directory.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced compatibility and upgrade problems with [product_name] projects created in earlier versions. Updating projects from [version_no] to newer releases like [version_no] and [version_no] led to errors and missing navigator content. While uploading to some devices is possible, the interface appears empty. Rebuilding the project from scratch with an older version can work, but causes loss of productivity. Further usability challenges include inconsistent font rendering and missing image previews between the editor and browser view.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect project migration across software versions to work smoothly, no errors after upgrades, improved webserver speed, and consistency in UI elements such as fonts and image previews.
